QuestInfo.name: Emergency Mission
QuestInfo.0: #r#p2410008##k, the strongest knight in #m321000100#, suspects a conspiracy. The Darklings that threaten the world, and the Shadow Knights who battle them... Just how far does the deceit extend? Why is #p2410008# forbidden from leaving Shadowvale? There's just not enough information.
QuestInfo.1: A dose of #rShade Neutralizer#k is required before undertaking any Shadow Knight missions, but the medicine has made #p2410008# susceptible to brainwashing. He stopped taking it some time ago.
QuestInfo.2: But why? Is everyone taking the Shade Neutralizer? Or is #p2410008# the only one?

npc.0: Report to Will for a dose of Shade Neutralizer, then report to area B-1 and do your thing.
